name: Bitter-eggplant salad
summary: Thin-sliced bitter eggplant, soaked and drained, tossed with fried dried anchovy, culantro, and a garlic-chili fish sauce. It is bitter from the eggplant, fragrant from the fish, and salty, sweet, and hot from the dressing.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 says gỏi cà đắng cá khô and canh cà đắng are the best-known bitter-eggplant plates.
howToEat: Order it with the bitter-eggplant soup; the salad is the simpler of the two.
where: Stilt-house meals in Buon Don, Lak, and Buon Ma Thuot.
seoTitle: Goi ca dang — bitter eggplant and dried fish
seoDescription: Bitter eggplant tossed with fried dried anchovy, culantro, and garlic-chili fish sauce: bitter, salty, sweet, and hot.
taste: Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 calls the salad bitter from the eggplant, fragrant from the fish, and salty, sweet, and hot from the sauce.
